description: Copies the source into a tree this block builds for itself and hangs it on a pointer cell. It builds a new tree only when the shape of the source changes, so it keeps a snapshot of a structure that can change shape, for example a parsed message.

activation.text: Runs when the source (the first input) is fresh, or on each pass an enable fires (an open gate, a tick), and the block is enabled. A clone is fresh for one pass only.

eno.description: Active on the passes a copy happened.

inputs.description: The object or tree to copy. The block runs when it is fresh.

An element of a pointer object the clone is attached to. Memory for the clone is taken only when the shape changes; while it stays the same the values are just refilled. The number of clones that can exist at once is limited.
